author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I need to seal the gaps between my exhaust fan and drywall. Great Stuff Wide Spray is a good option because it can fit in tight spaces. I use the white cone nozzle and seal the gaps from about 10 to 12 inches away. This also reduces the odds of condensation, which can cause mold and mildew issues. Learn more about Wide Spray at https://www.greatstuff.dupont.com/products/greatstuff-wide-spray.html?src=gs_na_paid-social_fy26widespray-influencer_youtube_v-homerepairtutor3-plt_2026-07-21
